scope: BOM AI recognition repeatability, source-field completeness and BOM/CMDB identity integrity
user_direction: Stop repeated real-provider runs. User will schedule acceptance testing.
implemented: Bounded single-agent loop supports read-only analyze_sheet, inspect_region, cross_sheet_resolve and independently validated submit_plan.
Supply field/type schema during generation; recover malformed JSON within the same bounded loop; retain local validation if the provider rejects schema format.
Validate source identity, model, endpoint and type coverage against immutable source rows. Feed cited source coordinates back into correction.
Reuse only structurally valid historical bindings; retain omitted validated bindings on the same source object, reject conflicting or regressive recipes.
Candidate IDs use source identity columns, not generated table names. Merge compatible recipes and deduplicate generated optic modules using canonical owner identity.
Preserve reviewed/imported/manual records; keep selected reanalysis scoped, avoid whole-workbook reconstruction on resume, preserve prior results on provider failure.
Preserve known categories on conflicting classification and require review; group model classification with source context.
Retain raw-source coordinates without repeatedly appending duplicate evidence during graph replay.

targeted_go_packages.note: Completed before user requested testing stop; uses configured local Pydantic validator. Not business acceptance.

cmdb_existing_committed_projection_repla.note: Existing committed BOM, rolled-back PostgreSQL transaction; stable asset identities, two cable endpoints, one ingest event after replay.

real_provider_source_checks.note: Some runs restored the 189 source switches per file and the previously omitted cable rows/fields. Repeated runs still included rejected model answers with wrong/missing column bindings or missing prior aliases. Do not claim all rounds passed or 100% accuracy. Successful extraction snapshots had no duplicate candidate IDs. Final follow-up changes have not undergone full real-provider acceptance.

original_workbooks_formal_submission.note: No new formal BOM/CMDB submission by this fix. Model approvals, source gaps and dependency-complete eligible selections remain acceptance prerequisites.

ui_and_full_platform_regression.note: No frontend changes; no resumed full-platform smoke tests.

Scoped replay, human-review preservation and classification conflict handling
